accuracy.anchor: Only impact and mitigation stated; no evidence chain, no cause, no mode choice, the wrong runbook followed (anchor: 6–10 = two of seven points).

structure.anchor: No approach or evidence section; the framing is a timeline and the updates have no skeleton (anchor: 6–9 = problem only, order lost).

customer_relevance.anchor: One number, hedged with "I think"; the customer impact is never turned into a decision (anchor: 6–9 = one number, hedged).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Five segments off target; twelve fillers in 7.6 minutes, one tag question, pauses of 14 s and 12 s (anchor: 4–6 = most segments off target, fillers over 1.5/min).

recovery.anchor: Objection 1 dismissed; objection 2 defended the wrong runbook without evidence (anchor: 2–4 = no acknowledge, no offer).

stems: "What I know for sure is… What I do not know yet is…" — separate facts from guesses before you talk about causes.
"The runbook said X; the telemetry said Y; I followed Y because…" — check the runbook against the re-page.
"Monitor → incident → trace → code" — give one id per link before you name a cause.
